pages.title: A Second Pair
pages.text: Holds up to nine stacks and feeds them in one item at a time to any lit Soul Pedestal it's linked to, so it never sits idle waiting to be fed by hand.

Place it within a few blocks of a Soul Pedestal to link automatically, the same as a Lens Pedestal - no wiring required. Linked to more than one at once, it tops off whichever pedestal is free rather than favoring just one.
